ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon 90 days' written notice to HDI, and for this purpose "Customer" means the Company. HDI may terminate this Agreement for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term, upon 90 days' written notice to Customer.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided the Termination Payment shall not exceed 3 months' fees.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made a Customer (the Company) right to terminate for convenience on 90 days' written notice operative, limited HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term on the same notice, and capped the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees. This is our fallback position on termination for convenience, which respects HDI's site build investment while giving us a genuine exit.
proposal.summary: Add a 90-day Customer convenience exit, limit HDI's convenience termination to end of term on 90 days' notice, and cap the Termination Payment at 3 months' fees.

mappings.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees.
